rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person's disapproval or dissatisfied reaction.

example.english: I have some disapproval of this arrangement.
example.traditional: 我對呢個安排有啲不滿。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 on1 paai4 jau5 di1 bat1 mun5

rows.note: Use this when the disapproval is opposition to a proposal, decision, action, or opinion.

example.english: I showed my disapproval by opposing the cancellation of the event.
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan2 deoi3 ceoi2 siu1 go3 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use this for strong, public, or official condemnation rather than ordinary personal disapproval.

example.english: The UN voiced its disapproval of the attack.
example.jyutping: lyun4 hap6 gwok3 hin2 zaak3 ni1 ci3 zaap6 gik1
